memory_candidates.content: In this agent-system's source store, an extension's manifest.json declares provides.scripts and provides.hooks as EXPLICIT file lists (core carries 407 and 27 entries), not globs. A new script or hook that is not declared there is simply not deployed by deploy-headless.sh, and check-extension-docs.sh's Rule Q (verify-deploy gate 3, commit-blocking) fails on an undeclared script. The sanctioned writer is sync-manifest-scripts.sh --write; never hand-edit the array. A new test suite carries two further coupled obligations: a TAB-separated row in scripts/tests/suite-classification.data (lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh fails loudly on an unclassified discovered suite) and compliance with gates 27 (lint-subject-resolution-declaration.sh) and 29 (lint-test-root-resolution.sh), both commit-blocking and both scoped to scripts/tests/*.sh. Any plan that adds a script, hook, or suite must declare manifest.json in the same phase's Files to modify block as the new file itself.
